job_post_detail.title: PMKT管培生-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Assist in product launches: Support senior teams in developing positioning, product strategies, and launch materials for new products; help collect customer feedback to optimize existing products.
2、Support market insights: Gather consumer, market, and competitive data; learn basic analysis tools to provide actionable insights for the team.
3、Explore vertical markets: Participate in market research to identify product-market fit and assist in tailoring key selling points for target segments.
4、Aid campaign execution: Contribute to new product launch activities and support performance tracking for core products.
5、Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with product, R&D, sales, and marketing teams to learn integrated workflows.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Education: Graduating with a bachelor’s/master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Communications, Statistics, or related fields.
- Key Competencies:
1、Communication skills: Good command of English (written & verbal) for daily work; ability to convey ideas clearly.
2、Fast learner: Passion for consumer tech/marketing; agility in mastering new skills.
3、Analytical mindset: Basic data sensitivity and logical thinking; proficiency in Office tools (Excel/PPT) for analysis.
4、Proactive & results-driven: Self-motivated with a “go the extra mile” attitude.
5、Team player: Collaborative spirit to thrive in cross-functional settings.
6、Curiosity & insight: Keen interest in consumer behavior and market trends.
7、Resilience: Adaptability in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
1、Interest/practical experience in photography/videography.
2、Internships/campus projects in marketing, market research, or product planning.
3、Basic data visualization skills (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

What You’ll Gain:
1、Structured training: Comprehensive product marketing curriculum, workshops, and 1:1 mentorship.
2、Real-world projects: Hands-on experience driving actual product campaigns.
3、Career growth: High-performing trainees may transition to **Product Marketing Specialist/Manager** roles.
4、Dynamic culture: Join an innovative, collaborative team.
